subsystem: Voice Subsystem Concurrency & Race Condition Defense

concurrency_scenarios.scenario: Acoustic Barge-In Interruption (Speech A vs Input B)
concurrency_scenarios.trigger: User begins speaking loudly while assistant is in SPEAKING state
concurrency_scenarios.mechanism: VoiceInterruptionController detects RMS >= baseline * 2.8, calls stop_speaking()
concurrency_scenarios.observed_behavior: Pygame mixer terminates instantly, speech queue cleared, system transitions to LISTENING

concurrency_scenarios.trigger: New assistant response arrives while previous response audio is playing
concurrency_scenarios.policy: SUPERSEDE: Active speech halted, fresh speech starts cleanly
concurrency_scenarios.mechanism: _speak_lock in FridayVoiceEngine and stop() in TextToSpeechOrchestrator
concurrency_scenarios.observed_behavior: Zero overlapping voices, zero phantom audio replay

concurrency_scenarios.scenario: Voice Input Concurrent With Typed Chat Command
concurrency_scenarios.trigger: User types in GUI command bar while voice loop is active
concurrency_scenarios.mechanism: Typed chat sends directly to query_llm without acquiring audio streams
concurrency_scenarios.observed_behavior: Typed chat finishes immediately without microphone contention

concurrency_scenarios.scenario: Continuous Conversation Multi-Turn Loop (10 Consecutive Turns)
concurrency_scenarios.trigger: User conducts rapid 10-turn dialogue in continuous hands-free mode
concurrency_scenarios.observed_behavior: Zero self-triggers, zero duplicated commands, stable memory footprint

concurrency_scenarios.trigger: Voice loop stopped while worker thread blocked in stream.read()
concurrency_scenarios.observed_behavior: Zero use-after-close errors, zero PaErrorCode -9977 / -9999 crashes
